expectations.text: Creates all four docs: README.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, STYLE.md
README follows the developer template's section structure exactly (headings present and in order)
STYLE.md skeleton: placeholders + unconfirmed-labeled Principles + Rule Priority default
STYLE.md uses concern-based sections, not a Backend/Frontend layer split
AGENTS.md documentation map links only to files that exist
